title: She bestowed fat pears neatly, head by tail, and among them ripe shamefaced peaches.
html_source: The description of these “fat pears” and “ripe shamefaced peaches” carries a sexual connotation, especially considering that Boylan is preparing for a sexual liaison and Bloom is buying erotic literature.
